mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_jobs ( case_id, search_condition_id, recording_id, job_type, status, prompt_snapshot, exclusion_prompt_snapshot, search_start_snapshot, search_end_snapshot, search_area_snapshot, similarity_threshold_snapshot, retry_count, requested_at ) VALUES ( #{caseId}, #{searchConditionId}, #{recordingId}, #{jobType}, #{status}, #{promptSnapshot}, #{exclusionPromptSnapshot}, #{searchStartSnapshot,typeHandler=com.ssafy.eyesonu.common.persistence.mybatis.UtcInstantTypeHandler}, #{searchEndSnapshot,typeHandler=com.ssafy.eyesonu.common.persistence.mybatis.UtcInstantTypeHandler}, #{searchAreaSnapshot}, #{similarityThresholdSnapshot}, 0, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) )
mapper.sql: id, case_id, search_condition_id, recording_id, job_type, status, prompt_snapshot, exclusion_prompt_snapshot, search_start_snapshot, search_end_snapshot, search_area_snapshot, similarity_threshold_snapshot, retry_count, error_message, requested_at, started_at, completed_at
mapper.update: UPDATE analysis_jobs SET status = 'RUNNING', started_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), completed_at = NULL, error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{jobId} AND job_type = 'RECORDING_ANALYSIS' AND status = 'QUEUED'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM analysis_jobs WHERE case_id = #{caseId} AND job_type = 'RECORDING_ANALYSIS' ORDER BY requested_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT FROM analysis_jobs WHERE id = #{jobId} AND job_type = 'RECORDING_ANALYSIS'
mapper.update: UPDATE analysis_jobs SET status = 'CANCELLED', completed_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE case_id = #{caseId} AND id = #{jobId} AND job_type = 'RECORDING_ANALYSIS' AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING')

UPDATE analysis_jobs SET status = 'QUEUED', retry_count = retry_count + 1, error_message = NULL, started_at = NULL, completed_at = NULL, requested_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE case_id = #{caseId} AND id = #{jobId} AND job_type = 'RECORDING_ANALYSIS' AND status = 'FAILED'
